scope: Actual stock TUI rendering, public native CRUD, real PTY keyboard/mouse; no model inference.

checks: real mouse wheel scrolls many long-title rows and restores the sidebar top
actual built plugin loaded in stock session sidebar; synthetic host sessions rendered
real keyboard mark/pin/Later actions persisted without changing native selection
completed title uses theme success, completion action uses theme warning, active/pin/Later primary row is deduplicated
real mouse collapses and expands Pinned with its activity summary retained
real keyboard open observed on native route; Later membership retained
real PTY mouse row opens its session directly; explicit row menu unmarks without changing Later
native create/rename/delete via real keyboard, cancellation preserves session and explicit mouse confirmation deletes
narrow 88x24 keyboard browse/action fallback remains usable
stock plugin deactivation/reactivation restores committed organization
20 paced native updates overlap real keyboard filtering; observed frames pass the declared p95 budget
new stock process hydrates organization; light terminal and Unicode browse render

limitations: Observer polling and public list reads add overhead; timing is an input-to-observed-frame upper bound, not isolated renderer latency.
This smoke does not create native busy, retry, permission or question events. See the separate attention probe and model tests for their explicitly stated scope.
No slow optional metadata provider is enabled; no Git or filesystem enrichment is performed by the UI.
No baseline CPU/memory, power-loss durability, remote transport or cross-platform rendering claim.
